mentions.name: Harbor
mentions.description: This CLI toolkit simplifies setting up and running local LLM software stacks with commands like `harbor up ollama webui`. It supports 17 backends (e.g., Ollama, llama.cpp), 14 frontends (e.g., Open WebUI), 50+ satellite projects, config profiles importable from a URL, tunnels, and a helper desktop app.
mentions.problem: Setting up multiple LLM runtimes across Python, Node, Go, and Rust with different environments, CUDA versions, and dependencies is tedious, and managing updates afterward is even worse.
mentions.audience: End users who want a simple way to run LLM stacks locally
mentions.source_excerpt:
So, I'm building a toolkit that allows to keep things simple for the end user.
Run Ollama and Open WebUI configured to work together: `harbor up ollama webui`. Don't like Ollama? Then `harbor up llamacpp webui`. There are 17 backends, 14 frontends and 50+ different satellite projects, config profiles that can be imported from a URL, tunnels, and a helper desktop app.
